findings.title: Late timed join can confirm cleanup after total deadline
findings.behavior: Timeout is derived only from thread liveness after join. No monotonic deadline-expiry check occurs after cleanup or serve join or before confirmed return. A timed join can overshoot while the thread stops, producing confirmed true after 2 seconds.
findings.impact: Future case receipt may derive cleanup_confirmed=true despite expiration of frozen total 2s cleanup deadline.
required_repair: After each join, mark timeout when monotonic current time > shared deadline even if stopped.
Recheck nonexpired finite clock before confirmed return; clock failure/nonfinite never confirms.
Optionally reject confirmed external result with elapsed_seconds>2.0 in _close_harness.
Add late-completion fake-clock regression requiring cached CLOSE_TIMEOUT and no retry.

from unittest.mock import patch
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime import combination_fixture as module
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.test_combination_fixture import FakeClock, FakeServeThread, FakeServer, owned_harness_for_close

class LateButCompletedThread:
    def __init__(self,target,*,daemon,clock):
        self.target=target;self.daemon=daemon;self.clock=clock;self.alive=True
    def start(self):
        return None
    def join(self,timeout=None):
        self.clock.now += (0.0 if timeout is None else timeout) + 0.25
        self.target();self.alive=False
    def is_alive(self):
        return self.alive

clock=FakeClock();serve=FakeServeThread();server=FakeServer(serve)
harness=owned_harness_for_close(server,serve)
def factory(*,target,daemon):return LateButCompletedThread(target,daemon=daemon,clock=clock)
with patch.object(module.threading,"Thread",side_effect=factory),patch.object(module.time,"monotonic",side_effect=clock.monotonic):
    result=harness.close()
print("confirmed="+str(result.confirmed))
print("timed_out="+str(result.timed_out))
print("error="+str(result.error))
print("elapsed_seconds="+str(result.elapsed_seconds))
print("shutdown_completed="+str(result.shutdown_completed))
print("threads_socket="+str((result.cleanup_thread_stopped,result.serve_thread_stopped,result.socket_closed)))
